name: NUS engineered MSC/5-flucytosine canine cancer study report
finding: The current official page is a results report published 19 January 2023 for an engineered MSC/cytosine-deaminase plus oral 5-flucytosine chemoimmunotherapy study begun in 2018; it reports 65 dogs and two cats treated, but publishes no present veterinary enrolment route.
catalog_comparison: This is a distinct historical treatment lead with no exact canonical ID. It remains unresolved and nonmatchable because current recruiting sites, eligibility, funding and owner intake are absent.
